message.reasoning_content:
need to determine crimes based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: They fraudulently obtained public land allocation and used it to get pension insurance benefits, collecting large sums of cash as "fees". Likely crimes: fraud (诈骗罪) or illegal acquisition of state property (非法占有国家财产罪) maybe "职务侵占罪"? They are village cadres using their positions to illegally transfer public land and obtain benefits. Could be "职务侵占罪" (embezzlement of public property by state functionary) or "国有资产犯罪". Also "诈骗罪" for obtaining money by false pretenses. They collected cash from relatives claiming to be fees for insurance but actually misappropriating. The act of using public land to get insurance benefits is illegal acquisition of state property. Under Chinese law, "非法占有国家财产罪" (illegal possession of state property) includes misappropriation of public land. Also "职务侵占罪" applies to state employees who appropriate public property for personal gain. They are village cadres, likely public officials. So crimes: "职务侵占罪" and "诈骗罪". Also maybe "行贿受贿"? No.

Thus answer: [罪名]职务侵占罪;诈骗罪<eoa>.
